_comment: Pinned sources for the bundled BiRefNet models (ADR-009, DOC-08 A8). The author (ZhengPeng7) publishes only PyTorch weights; these ONNX files are community conversions of his MIT weights, hosted by onnx-community on Hugging Face. Downloads are pinned to an exact revision and refused if the SHA-256 does not match. Only scripts/fetch-models.mjs ever downloads anything; the app itself never does (ADR-009).

lite.description: BiRefNet_lite fp16 - automatic cutout on every character/prop import

full.description: BiRefNet full fp16 - the 'HD cutout' option in the mask editor
